keynums.label: Manufacturing footprint
keynums.value: 1.5 lakh sq. ft. across 3 units, Surat

business.body:
- Vertically integrated manufacturer of elevator cabins, home lifts, automatic door systems and cabin safety frames, with an in-house stainless-steel processing/polishing division feeding its own elevator division.
- 1st public company in the elevator industry listed on the NSE SME platform, migrated to the mainboard in November 2020.
- Nationwide footprint with 700+ customers, supported by traders/warehouses across 14 named cities, plus exports to Kenya and Nepal and a stated Africa expansion focus.
- Operates as an OEM, supplying key components for complete elevator systems.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Management] Chairman & Managing Director Amar Chinubhai Doshi (36+ years in sheet metal fabrication); Whole Time Director Karan Amar Doshi heads production (16+ years); Director & CFO Monish Amar Doshi oversees finance/risk/sales (15+ years in sheet metal, 14+ years in the elevator sector).
- [Industry - Elevators] Global elevator market sized at USD 86.3B (2026) growing to USD 136.9B (2033) at a 6.8% CAGR; India is cited as the fastest-growing market globally at 9.9% CAGR (2026-2033), growth centred on Mumbai and Bengaluru high-rises.
- [Industry - SS Sheet] Global stainless-steel sheet market sized at USD 126.09B (2025) growing to USD 211.22B (2034) at a 5.9% CAGR, with Asia Pacific holding a 74.06% share (2025).
- [Strategic challenge] Deck explicitly flags that converting rising elevator/SS demand into steady long-term growth is currently limited by distribution reach, brand recall and short-term customer relationships, and states addressing these gaps is key to unlocking scalable growth.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: Aaron Industries positions itself as a vertically integrated elevator manufacturer that captures a second margin from in-house stainless-steel processing, now premiumising via the EVOQ360 home-lift and STELIX designer-steel brands.
